one_liner: Zendesk has a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 plus Basic/API-token options; developer access is via a free 14-day trial or a paid plan (sponsored accounts are Marketplace-partner only), and the MCP status is unverified from the pages.
auth_notes: The fetched ZIS page confirms OAuth 2.0 as the main method, with Basic authentication and API token as alternatives on some endpoints. The draft's claims about token deprecation dates and the global OAuth client requirement for multi-customer apps came from pages that were not provided, so they are unverified here.
access_notes: A free 14-day trial account is available. Sponsored accounts (no expiry, up to 5 agents) are reserved for Marketplace partners; customer or private-app developers should use their own instances or sandboxes. Some APIs need higher plans (ZIS: Suite Growth and above or Support Professional and above; Sunshine Profiles: Enterprise-level plans). The pages do not explicitly state that there is no free tier.
blocker_notes: Working credentials need a time-limited 14-day trial or a paid Zendesk plan; the sponsored account path is only for Marketplace partners. Some APIs need higher-tier plans. Other draft claims (global OAuth client approval, developer terms on customer tokens) are not verifiable from the provided pages.
